geeklist.title: [CLOSED] Euros, Promos, Miscellany! $1 Starting Bids! Auction Ends November 4. US shipping/ NYC local pickup available.
geeklist.description:
Some info:
[b]This auction is now CLOSED as of 9:35PM EST.[/b] I will be sending GMs asking for addresses for shipping shortly. This is a large undertaking so thank you in advance for your patience.
[b]The auction will end at a random time between 7-10PM EST on November 4, 2025.[/b] Any bids made in that time frame will extend the endpoint of that specific item by 5 minutes each.
[b]Shipping is from Brooklyn, NY 11205[/b], and will be charged upon completion of the auction. I will use Pirate Ship to determine the best price, unless otherwise asked, so please send your address as soon as possible once your item is won.
[b]Local pickup can also be arranged in and around NYC, if reasonable.[/b]
[b]Starting bids for most items will be $1. Bids must be in whole dollar amounts.[/b] If there is a Soft Reserve (SR) price listed, I reserve the right to choose not to sell to the highest bidder should this threshold not be met. Buy it Now (BIN) may also be available, in which case the auction for that item will close if that option is chosen. I reserve the right to sell any item outside of this auction if no bids have yet been made, but once any bid occurs that guarantees the item will be sold exclusively through this list.
[b]Payment is accepted through Paypal, Venmo, or Zelle.[/b] A cash option for local pickup is also available. Transactions will go through the BGG marketplace so they get their 3% cut.
Items are from a smoke-free home, and in excellent condition unless otherwise noted.
Feel free to Geekmail me with any further questions.
